name: Kirkland Signature Sliced Oven-Roasted Turkey Breast (3 x 14 oz)
whyItWorks: Whole-muscle turkey breast roasted and sliced thin without casing, dairy binders, or high fat fillers. It is gentle on the GI tract, offering fast protein for quick sandwich lunches.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer slices onto plain sourdough or white bread. Pair with potato chips or applesauce.
